summary: The ExpenseBatch class manages expense batch records within the HSPnet system, providing methods to add, search, update, and delete batch records. It includes procedures for handling batch IDs, descriptions, dates, status codes, and department associations.
purpose: To manage financial records related to expense batches including creation, modification, and retrieval of batch details.

workflows.name: Add Expense Batch
steps: Add parameters for departmentID, batchDescription, batchDate.
Execute query to insert record and retrieve its ID.

workflows.name: Search Expense Batch
steps: Execute query and read results to list ExpenseBatch records.

workflows.name: Update Expense Batch
steps: Add parameters for ID, batchDescription, batchDate, statusCodeID.

business_rules: Expense batches should be linked to a valid department ID.
Closed batches should have a ClosedDate value.
validations: Ensure ID is unique upon initial batch creation.
StatusDescription should reflect the current status code.

conditions.name: Check Alternate Language
conditions.description: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, use StatusDescriptionAlt; otherwise, use StatusDescription.

system_behavior: Ensure sessions are closed after database operations.
Use SQL stored procedures for batch operations.
exceptions: Handle null SqlDataReader results gracefully to prevent errors.
Ensure procedure names match those defined in the database.
